sloka: एते बहुविधा: शोका विलापरुदिते तथा ।वर्जनीया हि धीरेण सर्वावस्थासु धीमता ॥ २.१०५.३९॥
transliteration: ete bahuvidhā: śokā vilāparudite tathā ।varjanīyā hi dhīreṇa sarvāvasthāsu dhīmatā ॥ 2.105.39॥

translations.english: A wise man, holding on to his fortitude in all circumstances, should avoid such occasions of grief, these words of lamentation and this crying.
